reviews.text: With just two in-person sessions, my dogs stopped being reactive and are showing great improvement. Thank you!

Carlos's work is excellent. We saw results from the very first session, and his knowledge of dog training is remarkable. He has greatly helped us change our dog's habits and learn how to behave around him and train him properly.

We've been applying what Mr. Carlos taught us in session 1 with my dogs for four days now, and they've changed a lot. I know it takes patience and consistency, but I'm very happy with the changes we've made. They're calmer now, they fight less, and I have more authority (he explained and showed us how to be authoritative and what our dogs' body language is). One of them hasn't destroyed anything in the house. Previously, one of my dogs had worked with another trainer, and I didn't like it because we didn't address the root of the problems. Don't hesitate to contact Urban Dog Training CDMX; they come highly recommended. You'll see results from the very first session.

He's good, but I don't think he's a true ethologist because ethologists use other techniques to train dogs! They don't just scold, pinch, or throw things at them like Carlos did with my dog ​​on some occasions! Also, his lack of professionalism was a problem. The first session was fine; he arrived on time. After that, he stopped responding, and I had to contact him repeatedly to schedule the session. He would take up to four days to reply, and then, surprise, he couldn't make it or his car was broken down. This happened in the last two sessions as well.

I understand that there are things we can't control, but not responding for four days and then suddenly bringing it up is not normal. They shouldn't charge upfront. They should offer a trial class or an evaluation at a lower cost to see if we like their approach. Because, obviously, once you've paid in advance, you can't decide if you like the trainer's methods, and unfortunately, you have to put up with it because they obviously don't give refunds.

We are extremely happy with the training at home. I think they take their time in the sessions and give themselves the opportunity to get to know each dog's personality. I like that they train without mistreating the dogs, and we have seen positive changes from day one. I highly recommend them.

Excellent service. In just one week, my 4-year-old dog was a completely different dog, and as we progressed with the sessions, I noticed the changes more and more.
The instructions are easy to follow at home, and with consistency, the results continue to show.

While obedience training is certainly useful, it is entirely inappropriate and ineffective in treating reactivity in dogs. It fails to address the emotional chaos that causes reactivity.

It is misleading to say the trainer has the adequate experience or methodology to address our needs. And he should have known better and just admitted his limitations. I am sure he is adept at teaching obedience to dogs with obedience issues. Or teaching dogs how to focus their attention. But clearly not reactivity. This approach of forcing your dog to sit and tolerate their triggers is only useful as an example of methods that don’t work and should not continue to be used after 1990. If you want current, well-informed training practices that work, don’t look here. He only made our dogs’ reactivity worse. DON’T recommend for reactivity issues. We went with another service after him and saw improvement in literally 3 days. 3 days of proper training for reactivity.

The trainer was also wearing google glasses that were recording us without our knowledge. We were very uncomfortable that he did not mention it at all before we booked our training session. He agreed to stop wearing them when he came over, but we didn’t see him anyways after our first 3 sessions since we were unimpressed with our experience.

I chose dog training services primarily because they came to my home, as I wasn't comfortable with other options that required leaving my pet with them for a period of time for training.
From the very first session, Carlos explained in detail what my Sam needed, and with his instructions and recommendations, I could see changes in my pet's behavior. By the second session, we were able to take a calm and enjoyable walk with Sam, something I had considered impossible until a few months prior. Without a doubt, Carlos is very experienced and genuinely concerned about the well-being of dogs; the investment was absolutely worth it.
Carlos is an expert in dog behavior; in just two sessions he helped me tremendously with my dog's reactivity towards other dogs. I highly recommend him!

Our first session was incredible, something amazing and something I've never seen before at home with Kala. Today, now that I've started training her on my own and she's understood it quite well, it'll surely take little time to get her on track, thanks to what I learned yesterday.

Carlos and Sergio's work is excellent for training and handling our dogs.

Unfortunately, we had been through several trainers who used mistreatment as a tool, but with them, we see respect and, most importantly, affection for our dogs.
Although we are still in the training process and the results depend on the owners' (our) discipline, we have seen an improvement in their quality of life and a better response to instructions.

I highly recommend this dog training service in Cuauhtémoc and Mexico City. Before starting, my dog ​​couldn't control his energy, but now he knows how to wait, walk without pulling, and be calm around others. I saw results from the very first session.
I had tried other schools without success, and while searching online for dog training near my home, I found them as my first choice, and now I know why. Thank you so much.

I started working with Carlos when I moved to Mexico City with my dog. He has demonstrated incredible knowledge, and he's also very patient and always willing to help me understand what's best for my dog's stress reduction and for both of us to have a better life. I learned so much in just two sessions. I'm looking forward to continuing to learn from him!

Our experience with Carlos was excellent. His instructions and explanations were very clear. We felt more confident walking our dog after the second session. The prices are reasonable. In-home training is possible and very convenient for us. Thank you so much!
Excellent service, they helped me with 2 Maltese bichons and everything was perfect.
Our puppy is happy with the training, thank you for everything!

Carlos and his team have a lot of experience and the quality of their work is excellent. He helped us a lot with our dog's attachment, and he also takes very good care of the dogs at his boarding facility.

I highly recommend Mr. Carlos, a dog trainer and caretaker. He has taken excellent care of my dogs, always with patience and affection. He especially trained Theo wonderfully, achieving great progress with positive discipline and respect. I have also taken my dogs to his boarding facility, and it gives me great peace of mind knowing they are happy there: he doesn't keep them locked up; on the contrary, he takes them out, plays with them, and gives them the attention they need. It's clear he loves what he does, and that is reflected in the dogs' well-being.
The goal was achieved with a strong, large dog; the best part was bringing out its qualities 💖🐶 …

Carlos is good, but I relied on Google Maps reviews when deciding to contact him, and personally, we had two bad experiences due to Carlos's lack of professionalism. Here's what happened:

1. He arrived 30 minutes late for the first appointment.

2. For the second appointment (which we had already paid for), he called two hours before the scheduled time to say he wasn't driving and that we had to reschedule. We understand that unforeseen circumstances can arise, but there are Ubers and taxis available. If he were interested in being professional, there are many options to avoid standing a client up, especially since we told him we would shorten our trip to be able to meet him on time, as our priority was training our puppies. My husband said that was it; he preferred to lose his money rather than deal with someone so disrespectful of our time and so unprofessional. I suggested we give him one last chance.

3. He was supposed to confirm the time of our appointment yesterday, but he never did.
He trains my Golden Retriever and my Akita; he's very patient and his teaching style is excellent. I highly recommend him.
I've only had two classes with them and I've already noticed a big change in my dogs. They are very kind, clear, and punctual!

I contacted Carlos from Dog Training a few months ago when I decided to adopt a dog who had been a stray. I tried three trainers before finding Carlos, and he has truly been a great help in rehabilitating Barts, who used to get defensive and nervous around new dogs. We consistently continue working on everything we learn with Carlos, and he has improved a lot.

Carlos has helped us tremendously, and in addition to highly recommending his training, I also recommend their boarding service. I was away for two weeks on vacation, and Barts came back happy, calm, and confident. They took excellent care of him, and both he and I will continue to be happy to work with Carlos and the entire Dog Training team.

I highly recommend them.

We greatly appreciate you sharing your feedback on our in-home behavior modification service. It's gratifying to know that the personalized sessions are working and have improved your relationship with your dogs.

They're the best! Patient and very clear. They follow up with us between sessions. We've only had two sessions and we're already seeing changes in our dog.

They're helping us make a difference in our relationship.

Carlos is amazing. It's incredible how quickly he worked with our dog. I loved his training philosophy, and our dog was very calm during the session. He gave me tons of ideas and exercises to work on with my dog. I'm excited to see the results from his guidance. I highly recommend him!

Excellent service, they are the best professionals I've ever seen. Results were visible from the first session; in just two hours they resolved a behavioral problem that had lasted for many months. I 100% recommend their services, and I will definitely continue with the classes.
I constantly leave my fur babies in the care and training of a professional. They're in very good hands and they're very happy 🥰🥰🥰 …
It's always good to have dog training. My dog ​​loves it. She comes back calm and well-balanced. Excellent service from Carlos and his team.
It's an excellent service!!! Charly is a great pet trainer!!
Excellent service from Carlos, good advice and guidance, very open to understanding my pet's concerns

Carlos was the assigned instructor, and in addition to being punctual, he demonstrated his experience by observing and recommending very specific exercises to help the puppy's well-being 🐕
The caregivers' commitment is essential to see results from the very first session!!! And with the love I feel for my pet 🐶, I can attest that practicing the exercises recommended by Carlos produces positive results!!!

The ethologist explained the steps to follow to change his behavior. 🤩 I'm so grateful to the Urban Dog Training MX team. My dog ​​was very restless, disobedient, and barked constantly. We noticed a big change from the very first in-home session. They were respectful, and their training approach really works. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for professional and humane training at home.
My two-year-and-one-month-old Belgian Shepherd mix is ​​very well-trained, so I am very grateful to have put him in the hands of specialists in this field.

I'm very grateful to the Urban Dog Training MX team. My dog ​​was very restless and didn't always obey. We noticed a big change from the very first in-home session. They were very respectful. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for professional dog training.
Excellent service. In one visit, they answered many of my questions and helped improve my dog ​​Lola's behavior. I highly recommend them.
For me, trainer Carlos is a very professional person. And I was very satisfied with the dogs he trained for me.
I've had great results following Carlos's training program. I highly recommend it.

After two years of working with my dog ​​and several trainers, we were very frustrated. I truly thought we were beyond help. Then we met Carlos, and the work he did was a relief. He really understood Mila, and his recommendations were very effective. Mila transformed, and our relationship improved considerably. I highly recommend him. We had to move far away, and it's a shame he can no longer support us, but we always remember him fondly. Mila was very happy at the boarding kennel, and I could go to work knowing she would be safe and sound. Thank you so much!

Excellent service, one of the most passionate and dedicated professionals I've met in the field of ethology.

His ability to observe and analyze animal behavior is impressive, and his knowledge of the subject is exceptional. His holistic and respectful approach to animals is truly inspiring.

Furthermore, his ability to communicate his findings and knowledge clearly and accessibly is outstanding. He has been an invaluable guide for my five dogs. 🙂 Highly recommended.

The training of my husky was excellent; it was very beneficial and the changes were noticeable. It was done professionally.
Highly recommended.

I highly recommend the services provided. I have three dogs of different breeds and sizes, and the sessions (held at my home) have been very effective. In three weeks, I've seen a change in their behavior and also in the bond we have with them.

Alfonso is an excellent professional. He has a great attitude and explains things in a simple way so that, as owners, we know how to care for our dogs. As a result, my dog ​​has shown great improvement in her daily life after taking the classes. I'm very satisfied with him and highly recommend him.
Excellent instructor
Excellent service from the coach, very attentive and precise with the instructions
It was a pleasure to do the training course with you all 😊 …
Jorge's service was very good and excellent.

I loved the consultations with trainer Jorge. He's clear and precise in the information he provides and in the techniques to implement with the pet to correct the inappropriate behavior the furry friend is exhibiting. Thank you so much, Jorge, for sharing your experience!
Excellent trainer, very responsible. Great customer service... highly recommended!
My puppy and I are going through the process and we've seen so many changes, thank you so much!
